description: $0.05 USDC on Solana per report - the payment buys one comparison of the two artefacts you submitted (streamed capture + reference output) and one signed divergence report: byte-equal or not, both chunk counts and byte lengths, the first-divergence offset or NONE, and every differing span by position and length. The report does not establish which output is correct, nor why they diverged.

reference_output.description: One artefact: {chunks: [base64 chunk, ...]} - chunk boundaries preserved as submitted; up to 1,024 chunks and 65,536 decoded bytes.

streamed_capture.description: One artefact: {chunks: [base64 chunk, ...]} - chunk boundaries preserved as submitted; up to 1,024 chunks and 65,536 decoded bytes.
